scripts.dev:api: astro build && npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply portfolio-questions --local && npx wrangler@4 dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply portfolio-questions --remote
scripts.questions: npx wrangler@4 d1 execute portfolio-questions --remote --command "SELECT asked_at, section, question FROM questions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
